name: answer-first
summary: Agent skill of eleven rules that move the answer to the top of every reply, with no preamble.
description: One skill, installed via the skills CLI or by dropping SKILL.md into ~/.claude/skills/answer-first/. Eleven rules keep replies bottom-line-up-front: the answer in sentence one, numbered multi-step work, one concrete next step at the end, no tangents, flat tone on errors, options capped at five; rules 1-10 are adapted from i-have-adhd (MIT) and stay active for the rest of the conversation once invoked.
contains: 11 rules incl. bottom line up front
